# App state vendor

Standalone Foundation module ported from ProjectX/tools/app-state. Complete core/native adapters/session/CLI/tests and source license are retained; see SOURCE.md. No runtime dependency on ProjectX, its UIKit UI, profiles, tweak or daemon.

Public facade: include/TVAppStateServices.h. TVASRequest validates external commands and maps opaque backup IDs to bounded relative references. TVAppStateServices resolves the installed target, copies/signs/verifies an exact-group disposable worker, runs it and cleans private artifacts. Native container/keychain/identity verification and store/session locks remain in the original engine. The persistent host receives metadata/progress, never keychain record contents.

RootHide/iOS15+ native integration uses src/TVASRuntime.m and packaged product/Worker.m plus cli/VendorWorker.m. Core tests remain host-portable; unsupported deployment schemes fail instead of guessing jailbreak layouts. Backups use the independent real-rootfs /var/mobile/Media/TrollVNCAppStateBackups store, with bootstrap-owned association/operation state under /var/mobile/Library/TrollVNC/AppState. Existing ProjectX stores are not reused automatically.

Commands: list, describe, save, createBaseline, switch, edit, delete. Public socket task32 and exact parameter contract: [TrollVNC integration](../../docs/app-state-zxtouch.md). Native call requests are generated by TVASRequest; do not accept caller-provided filesystem roots, keychain groups, helper commands or references.

Run from TrollVNC:

```sh
rtk proxy sh vendor/app-state/build.sh test
rtk proxy bash tests/run_app_state_socket_tests.sh
```

The retained CLI/build.sh ios is a diagnostic interface inherited from ProjectX. Production builds the facade and two packaged workers through app-state.mk and TrollVNC's Makefile. Historical ProjectX validation in docs/INTEGRATION.md is source evidence, not proof of TrollVNC on-device acceptance. New verification is recorded in docs/VALIDATION.md.
